name: Sparse NeRF Reconstruction with Geometric and Semantic Initialization
aliases: Geometric initialization based on depth prior and semantic segmentation
definition: A full-process reconstruction method for sparse input (15-20 images) that addresses blurred geometry, loss of detail, and slow convergence by using COLMAP sparse point clouds for geometric priors and Mask R-CNN for semantic-guided weight initialization.
summary: This method stabilizes NeRF reconstruction from sparse images by combining COLMAP depth priors with Mask R-CNN semantic segmentation to accelerate convergence and improve fidelity.
